_about: Public-domain Henry Alford (1810-1871, Dean of Canterbury) for the Word Hoard: The Greek Testament, with a critically revised text, a digest of various readings and a critical and exegetical commentary, vols 1, 2 and 4 of 4, raw Internet Archive OCR: vols 1-2 from London (Rivington, catalogued 1849-56), vol. 4 from the Boston (Lee and Shepard) issue catalogued 1874. The volumes come from different printings of a work Alford revised edition by edition. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Vol. 1's text layer carries no Greek characters (its Greek was read as Latin letters); vols 2 and 4 carry Greek. Overlap: PR #11's build_commentaries.py plans a verse-keyed Alford; this shelf's raw OCR is a second copy, and Adam picks which is the reading of record.

alford-greek-testament-1: The Greek Testament, vol. 1: the Four Gospels (London: Rivington; catalogued 1849)
alford-greek-testament-2: The Greek Testament, vol. 2: Acts to Second Corinthians (London: Rivington; catalogued 1856)
alford-greek-testament-4: The Greek Testament, vol. 4: Hebrews to Revelation (Boston: Lee and Shepard; catalogued 1874)
